title: tribulus grandiflorus
intro: Tribulus grandiflorus, commonly known as Chinese Caltrops or Chinese Tribulus, is a plant species in the Capparaceae family, characterized by its thorny, annual herbaceous nature. The health benefits of Tribulus grandiflorus include its potential to improve cardiovascular function, boost libido, and support kidney health due to its diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating effects. The bioactive constituents of Tribulus grandiflorus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
